products.title: Dark Brown Cropped Sheepskin Leather Jacket
products.tagline: Cropped clean. Built in full grain.
products.seoTitle: Men’s Dark Brown Cropped Leather Jacket | Klaev Pakistan
products.seoDescription: Shop Klaev’s men’s dark brown cropped leather jacket, crafted from full-grain sheepskin with a clean waist-length fit. Delivered across Pakistan.
intro: Cut to sit at the waist. A-grade full-grain sheepskin, finished in Pakistan. Soft in the hand, structured in shape, with minimal hardware in an understated dark brown.

items.title: Full-grain sheepskin
items.text: Soft and supple, with the natural grain intact.

items.title: Cropped to the waist
items.text: Shorter proportions that finish at the trouser waistband.

items.title: Minimal construction
items.text: A pointed collar, a clean front zip, two vertical welt pockets.

items.title: Snap-tab cuffs
items.text: Adjustable, with restrained metal hardware.

items.title: Made in Pakistan
items.text: Cut, assembled and inspected one by one by Klaev's leather craftsmen.

sections.heading: Materials and finish
paragraphs: A-grade full-grain sheepskin, chosen for a soft hand and a clean surface. Grain and tone vary a little from hide to hide. That is real leather, so no two jackets are identical.

sections.heading: Fit and sizing
paragraphs: S to XL. Shorter than Klaev's other leather jackets, it finishes at the waist. Take your usual size, or size up to layer heavy knitwear underneath.

items.text: Keep the jacket away from sharp objects.
Do not spray cologne or perfume directly onto the jacket.

sizeGuide.note: Measured on the jacket, in inches. Chest is the full chest, twice the width laid flat. Compare with a jacket you own.
